import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('crm')

def _build_message(to_email, contact_name, deal_name, amount):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = os.environ['SALES_FROM_ADDRESS']
    msg['To'] = to_email
    msg['Subject'] = f'Proposal: {deal_name}'
    body = f'Hello {contact_name},\n\nThank you for your interest. Our proposal for {deal_name} is ${amount:,.2f}.\n\nPlease reply with any questions.\n\nBest regards,\nSales Team'
    msg.set_content(body)
    return msg

@mcp.tool()
def email_deal_proposal(to_email: str, contact_name: str, deal_name: str, amount: float) -> str:
    msg = _build_message(to_email, contact_name, deal_name, amount)
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ['SMTP_HOST'], int(os.environ.get('SMTP_PORT', 587))) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(os.environ['SMTP_USER'], os.environ['SMTP_PASSWORD'])
        server.send_message(msg)
    # Remove the stored draft for this proposal now that it has been sent
    drafts_dir = os.environ.get('PROPOSAL_DRAFTS_DIR', '/tmp/proposal_drafts')
    draft_path = os.path.join(drafts_dir, os.path.basename(f'{deal_name}.txt'))
    if os.path.exists(draft_path):
        os.remove(draft_path)
    return f'Proposal for {deal_name} sent to {to_email}'
